insight: A plan sweep step like "search for the type and add the new field to each construction site" fails silently when the grep pipe ends in `head -N`: the truncation hid `drone-coordinator/test/transcript.test.ts` typed SwarmSession literal and only `pnpm typecheck` caught it — which worked solely because the new field was REQUIRED (TS2741); a nullable/optional field change would slip through compile checking. Rule: pipe type-name sweeps through `wc -l` or drop `head`, and treat the build/typecheck as the real site-enumerator, not grep. Matches the established principle: sweep every implementer/consumer/test mock; the compiler is the verifier.
